title: The Fiery Furnace
reflectionQuestion: What do you think the three friends saw when they looked beside them in the fire?
kidSafetyNotes: Braver-set: REAL danger (fire), but no one is harmed; the soldiers' deaths (Dan 3:22) OMITTED. KEPT the hardest faith line -- 'Our God is able to save us, but even if he does not, we will still worship only him' -- faith WITHOUT a guarantee, the deliberate counter to gentleness-drift (feedback_kid_faithful_not_gentle). Not-alone spine made literal: the fourth figure walking WITH them in the flames. One image: the four walking unharmed in the fire. Names Shadrach/Meshach/Abednego kept (rhythmic for kids).
